component.name: AccountScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.deviceIdentity = invalid m.top.entitlement = invalid m.top.onRefresh = false m.top.onBack = false m.macValue = m.top.findNode("macValue") m.keyValue = m.top.findNode("keyValue") m.planValue = m.top.findNode("planValue") m.statusValue = m.top.findNode("statusValue") m.expiryValue = m.top.findNode("expiryValue") m.playlistCountValue = m.top.findNode("playlistCountValue") end sub
sub setAccountInfo(identity as object, entitlement as object) m.top.deviceIdentity = identity m.top.entitlement = entitlement m.macValue.text = identity.mac ? identity.mac : "" m.keyValue.text = identity.key6 ? identity.key6 : "" m.planValue.text = entitlement.plan ? entitlement.plan : "TRIAL" m.statusValue.text = entitlement.status ? entitlement.status : "trial" m.expiryValue.text = formatExpirationDate(entitlement.expiresAt ? entitlement.expiresAt : "") m.playlistCountValue.text = (entitlement.playlistCount ? entitlement.playlistCount : 0) + " / 5" end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) if key = 283 m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
sub formatExpirationDate(expiresAt as string) as string if expiresAt = "" return "Never" end if dt = createObject("roDateTime") dt.fromISO8601String(expiresAt) if dt.isValid() monthNames = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"] return monthNames[dt.getMonth()-1] + " " + dt.getDayOfMonth().toStr() + ", " + dt.getYear().toStr() end if return expiresAt end sub
